methodologyNotes: Prices fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. GitHub Copilot Business/Enterprise prices corroborated from GitHub Docs. Windsurf domain (windsurf.com) now permanently redirects to devin.ai (308); Codeium.com redirects to windsurf.com then to devin.ai — all Windsurf plans recorded from devin.ai/pricing. Tabnine does not publish a free plan on its pricing page; both plans are annual-only with no listed month-to-month rate. JetBrains AI Assistant official pricing pages returned 404 or rendered empty (JS-only); price recorded from third-party comparison aggregators (slashdot.org, sourceforge.net) showing $8.33/month — treat as approximate and flag in notes. Sourcegraph Cody individual/free plans were not found on sourcegraph.com/pricing as of this date; only Enterprise ($16K/year) is listed. Replit Core annual rate is $20/mo; month-to-month rate is $25/mo. Replit Pro annual rate is $95/mo; month-to-month is $100/mo. monthlyUsd set to annual-equivalent rate with notes for month-to-month rate where both are known. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on all plans (non-telephony product vertical).

vendors.name: GitHub Copilot
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://github.com/features/copilot/plans on 2026-06-14. Business/Enterprise prices corroborated from https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/about-github-copilot/subscription-plans-for-github-copilot.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2,000 code completions/month, access to Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5 mini, Copilot CLI included. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited code completions, cloud agent access, code review, $15/month AI credits. As of 2026-06-14 new sign-ups are temporarily paused.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.notes: Premium models including Claude Opus, audit logs, $70/month AI credits. 4x+ usage vs Pro. New sign-ups paused as of 2026-06-14.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Priority access to new models, $200/month AI credits. Designed for sustained agent workflows.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Organizational license management, IDE, CLI, and GitHub Mobile access. Per granted seat per month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Everything in Business plus GitHub.com native integration, codebase indexing, custom fine-tuned model access. Per granted seat per month.

vendors.name: Cursor
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://www.cursor.com/pricing on 2026-06-14.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Limited Agent requests and Tab completions. No credit card required.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Includes Pro, Pro+, and Ultra sub-tiers all at $20/month. Extended Agent limits, frontier model access, MCPs/skills/hooks, cloud agents. Bugbot billed usage-based separately.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Per user per month. Centralized billing and administration, team marketplace, agentic code reviews, shared context cloud agents, usage analytics, SAML/OIDC SSO, team-wide privacy mode.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing via invoice/PO. Includes pooled usage, SCIM seat management, repository/model/MCP access controls, audit logs, AI code tracking API, priority support.

vendors.name: Tabnine
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://www.tabnine.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. Both plans are annual-only subscriptions; no monthly billing rate is published.

plans.name: Code Assistant Platform
plans.notes: Annual subscription only ($39/user/month billed annually). AI code completions, AI-powered chat for full SDLC, Atlassian Jira integration, flexible deployment (SaaS/VPC/on-prem/air-gapped), zero code retention, GDPR/SOC 2/ISO 27001 compliance, IP protection.

plans.name: Agentic Platform
plans.notes: Annual subscription only ($59/user/month billed annually). Everything in Code Assistant plus autonomous agents, Tabnine CLI, Context Engine with unlimited codebase connections, MCP tools (Git, testing frameworks, Jira, Confluence, Docker, CI/CD). Headless Agents optional add-on.

vendors.name: Windsurf (now Devin)
vendors.provenance: windsurf.com permanently redirects (308) to devin.ai as of 2026-06-14. Pricing fetched from https://devin.ai/pricing on 2026-06-14. The page states 'Windsurf is now Devin Desktop.'

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Light quota to code with agents; limited model access. Daily and weekly usage allowance refreshes.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Most popular plan. Increased quotas and full model availability. Overage charges available at API pricing.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Significantly higher quotas than Pro. Overage charges available at API pricing.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $80 base fee + $40 per developer seat/month. Unlimited team members, centralized billing and analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Dedicated support and deployment options.

vendors.name: Replit
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://replit.com/pricing on 2026-06-14.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free daily Agent credits, built-in database, create slides/videos/animations, publish up to 1 project, private/password-protected deployments.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Annual rate $20/month. Month-to-month rate is $25/month (20% annual discount). Includes $25 monthly credits, up to 5 collaborators, 2 parallel agents, multi-region publishing, unlimited workspaces, removes branding badge.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual rate $95/month. Month-to-month rate is $100/month (5% annual discount). Includes $100 monthly credits, up to 15 collaborators, 50 viewers, 10 parallel agents, most powerful models, 28-day database rollbacks, premium support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Custom seat limits, SSO/SAML, advanced privacy controls, design system support, data warehouse connections, single-tenant environments, VPC peering, static IPs.

vendors.name: Amazon Q Developer
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://aws.amazon.com/q/developer/pricing/ on 2026-06-14. Corroborated from https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazonq/latest/qdeveloper-ug/pricing.html.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 agentic requests/month, latest Claude models, IDE and CLI usage, reference tracking, public code suppression, AWS Console Q&A and error diagnosis, 1,000 lines of code/month for Java transformation.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user per month, pro-rated first month. Increased agentic request limits, 4,000 lines of code/month for Java/.NET transformation (pooled at account level), Identity Center support, admin dashboards, IP indemnity, automatic opt-out for data collection. Overage for code transformation at $0.003/line.

vendors.name: Sourcegraph Cody
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched from https://sourcegraph.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. No self-serve individual or team plans were listed; only Enterprise at $16K/year starting. Cody.dev redirects to sourcegraph.com/cody which contained no pricing information. Individual/free Cody plans appear to have been discontinued or are not publicly listed.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $16,000/year (annual commitment). Includes AI-powered Deep Search, Code Search, Batch Changes, Insights, Monitoring, MCP Server, APIs, CLI. Credit-based AI usage with org-wide pooling and rollover on renewal. Scales with team size. Contact sales required.

vendors.name: JetBrains AI Assistant
vendors.provenance: Official JetBrains AI pages (jetbrains.com/ai/) render JS-only and returned empty content on 2026-06-14, so price was confirmed via reputable third-party comparison sources. The standard entry-level paid tier (AI Pro) is $10/month (~$100/year annual). The prior $8.33/month figure (a $100/12 derived rate from stale aggregator listings) does not match any current credible source and was corrected. AI Pro is also bundled free with the All Products Pack and dotUltimate subscriptions; a free tier exists.

plans.name: AI Pro
plans.notes: Entry-level paid JetBrains AI tier at $10/month (~$100/year if billed annually). Corroborated by multiple independent 2026 comparison sources; official jetbrains.com/ai page is JS-rendered and returned no parseable content on 2026-06-14. Free tier and higher AI Ultimate tier ($30/month) also exist. AI Pro is included free with the All Products Pack and dotUltimate subscriptions. Inline AI completions, chat, and code generation within all major JetBrains IDEs.
